cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll hand out the refund forms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. The forms will need my full attention.
